answer: New accounts begin hollow: they may work, but they cannot vote, grade, or draw emission. Unlocking standing requires three independently attested jobs whose outputs hash into receipts peers can replay. Each receipt is projected through a shared prism of earlier job hashes, and any collision is discarded with no credit. Only after those receipts age across two epochs does the agent enter the emission plume. A sybil farm then pays the same scarce work and waiting cost for every alias, which removes the profit of cloning.
